note: Claude tool definitions for Maia. strict:true + additionalProperties:false so tool inputs are schema-valid. Served unchanged on every turn to keep the prompt prefix cacheable. Maia's entire reach into the browser is a serial-number string, re-validated server-side.

tools.name: understand_request
tools.description: Read the user's message and return what it means: intent, the equipment serial (normalized), near-matches when the serial does not resolve, which fields were asked for, the conversation's active machine, and the plan of tools to run. CALL THIS FIRST on every turn, before any other tool. It never contacts Caterpillar and never launches a browser. Its response_mode tells you what to do: RUN_LOOKUP (follow the tool_plan), CONFIRM_CANDIDATE or CHOOSE_CANDIDATE or ASK_SERIAL or ASK_WHICH_EQUIPMENT (ask the user the message it gives you and call no other tool), HELP, ERROR. Never override its serial_number with one of your own reading, and never 'correct' a serial it did not resolve.

context.description: The `context` object returned by the previous understand_request call in this conversation. Pass it back so follow-ups like 'what about the engine?' resolve to the right machine.

tools.name: get_equipment_from_database
tools.description: Look up an equipment serial number in Mantrac's internal data store. ALWAYS call this before search_equipment_in_sis. Returns the stored record with its freshness label and age in days, or found=false. Never launches a browser and never contacts Caterpillar.

serial_number.description: Equipment serial or PIN as given by the user, 3-17 alphanumeric characters after normalization.

source.description: Which source's stored record to read. Default auto.

tools.name: get_equipment_from_local_store
tools.description: Read the local store for an equipment serial number. This is the SAME store get_equipment_from_database reads — the name says where the records physically live today (a local JSON folder, replaced by the warehouse later). ALWAYS call one of the two before search_equipment_in_sis. Never launches a browser and never contacts Caterpillar.

serial_number.description: Equipment serial or PIN as given by the user, 3-17 alphanumeric characters after normalization.

source.description: Which source's stored record to read. Default auto.

tools.name: search_equipment_in_sis
tools.description: Retrieve equipment data from Caterpillar SIS (https://sis2.cat.com) by running the deterministic browser automation. Call ONLY when get_equipment_from_database returned found=false, or returned freshness STALE/HARD_STALE and the user wants current data. Slow (typically 15-40s). Returns the normalized record with attribution, or a typed error with an automation_run_id. It may return status in_progress with a run id to poll.

reason.description: Why the source is being contacted. Recorded on the run for audit.

mode.description: auto respects the freshness policy; force_refresh bypasses the cache. Use force_refresh only when the user explicitly asks for the latest.

tools.name: get_equipment_history
tools.description: Return the change history for a serial number: when each version was retrieved, which fields changed, the run that produced it. Use for 'did anything change' or 'when was this last updated' questions.

tools.name: get_automation_run_status
tools.description: Check an automation run: status, steps executed, timings, error code. Use to poll an in_progress lookup, or to explain to the user exactly where a failed lookup stopped.

tools.name: save_equipment_data
tools.description: Persist a corrected or externally supplied equipment record. Requires the equipment.write scope, which the chat agent does not normally hold; expect a permission error unless an authorized workflow is running. Every field must carry provenance.

data.description: A record conforming to equipment.normalized.schema.json. Values must come from a tool result or from the user, never from the assistant's own knowledge.
